title: Much Ado About Nothing
subtitle: 30th Summer Season · Directed by David Frederick Mold
description:
Thank you for 30 seasons of storytelling under the stars, and for Much Ado About Nothing in June 2026. Shakespeare's sparkling comedy transported audiences to 19th-century Sicily, where romance bloomed, tempers flared, and a battle of wits became a battle of hearts.

That run has ended. VIP reserved seating pre-sale was April 7–14, and general admission opened April 15. Nothing from the June calendar is on sale.
location: Shakespeare in Pinkney Park, 177 Rowayton Avenue, Rowayton, CT

calendar.recurrenceNote: Ran Wed–Sun evenings through June 28, 2026 (no Mondays).

ticketDetails: General admission: $25 adults, $5 children 12 and under (Wed–Sun evenings)
Student & senior rush: $15 (65+ and current students, in person at box office day-of only)
Pay-What-You-Will: Tuesday June 16 & 23 at 7:30pm (suggested $25 adults, $5 children)
Apprentice Company matinee Saturday June 20 at 1pm — walk-up admission only
specialEvents: Opening Night Pre-show Reception — Saturday June 13, 6–7:30pm ($50 with Main Stage ticket)
Directors' Discuss Much Ado — Sunday June 14, 6–6:45pm
SOS Book Club — Thursday June 18 ($25 with Main Stage ticket; rain date June 25)
Alumni Night Reception — Saturday June 20, 6–7:30pm ($50 with Main Stage ticket)
creativeTeam: Set Design: Brian Prather · Lighting: Jamie Roderick
Costumes: Grier Coleman · Sound/Composer: Chad Rains

title: Shakespeare for Kids
subtitle: Kids' Show · Accessible in the Park
description:
A 30-minute version of Much Ado About Nothing for ages 1–100! A kid-friendly adaptation by our Apprentice Company that also serves as a refresher for those who need a plot reminder.

6:30pm in the park, every night before the MainStage show. Kids' Shows are accessible to all — show up, find a spot, and enjoy! To book at your library or school, visit our Learning page.
location: Shakespeare in Pinkney Park, Rowayton, CT
